title: A naturalist's dawn birding routine
storyboard: Film: naturalist at first light lacing boots, scanning with binoculars, writing in a field notebook (POV)

scenes.headline: 5:30 AM. Boots on, phone on silent.
Step 1: listen before you look
scenes.body: Oriental pied hornbills, Khao Yai National Park, Thailand.

scenes.headline: Step 2: stand still, let the birds carry on
Step 3: write it down — time, place, behaviour
scenes.body: Brown-winged kingfisher: straight into the notebook.

scenes.headline: Many birds call most at first light
scenes.body: A Cornell Lab study in India's Western Ghats found many species far more vocal at dawn than at dusk.

caption:
My morning routine, but make it birds.

The same Western Ghats study found little support for the old idea that birds sing at dawn simply because sound carries better then.

Source: Cornell Lab of Ornithology. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
